issues.reason: Storing neither creates, destroys, consumes nor physically changes the essence — the Thematic-roles test assigns a merely relocated / kept object to Theme (the list names 'keep' and 'use' explicitly, and unclear cases default to Theme), so (Patient (sk_store $x) mire_essence) mis-types the role.

new_gaps: Bare-plural object of an oblique inside a generic rule ('stores ... in clay vessels'): the oblique-object rule covers an article (mint a witness), a bare mass / domain / proper name (a constant), and Coordination & plurals covers bare-plural objects only in EPISODIC clauses, so nothing states whether a bare-plural oblique filler in a rule conclusion takes the bare kind constant (as here) or a per-occurrence Skolem group.
defect_summary: The compliant form replaces the role atom with (Theme (sk_store $x) mire_essence); the rest of the rule stands unchanged.
notes: The whenever routing, the During tie, the two compound genera with their noun modifiers correctly unexposed, the per-occurrence Skolem Keeper, and Location-on-the-event-only for the positioning verb are all per spec.
